ar.title: الطحال المحشي المسلوق

steps.n2: يُتبل بالملح والفلفل ونصف مقدار عصير الليمون ويُترك حوالي ربع ساعة.
steps.n3: يوضع في إناء ويُغطى بالماء ويُضاف إليه البصل وباقي عصير الليمون وقليل من الملح، ويُرفع على النار حتى يغلي، ثم تُهدأ الحرارة ويُترك حتى ينضج.
steps.n4: يُرفع من الماء، وتُخلط مقادير الصلصة من المرق والزيت والليمون وتُتبل بالملح والفلفل.
steps.n5: يُقطع شرائح غليظة ويُرص في صحن ويُجمل بالليمون والبقدونس، ويُقدم معه الصلصة.
steps.n6: أو يُشوّح قليلاً في السمن المقدوح ويُقدم مع البقدونس والليمون، مع مراعاة تغطية إناء التحمير لأن الطحال يفرقع، وقلبه على الوجه الآخر ثم تغطيته.

en.title: Boiled Spleen

steps.n1: Wash the spleens with flour and clean them well.
steps.n2: Season with salt, pepper and half the lemon juice and leave for about a quarter of an hour.
steps.n3: Put them in a pot, cover with water and add the onion, the rest of the lemon juice and a little salt; bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cook until tender.
steps.n4: Lift them out of the water; mix the sauce ingredients (broth, oil and lemon) and season with salt and pepper.
steps.n5: Cut into thick slices, arrange on a plate, garnish with lemon and parsley and serve with the sauce.
steps.n6: Or sauté briefly in very hot ghee and serve with parsley and lemon, keeping the frying pan covered because spleen spatters; turn it over, then cover again.

legacySteps: Wash the spleens with flour and clean them well.
Season with salt, pepper and half the lemon juice and leave for about a quarter of an hour.
Put them in a pot, cover with water and add the onion, the rest of the lemon juice and a little salt; bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cook until tender.
Lift them out of the water; mix the sauce ingredients (broth, oil and lemon) and season with salt and pepper.
Cut into thick slices, arrange on a plate, garnish with lemon and parsley and serve with the sauce.
Or sauté briefly in very hot ghee and serve with parsley and lemon, keeping the frying pan covered because spleen spatters; turn it over, then cover again.
